definitions.explanation: Indicates that something has not yet been officially verified or identified. Common in news reporting and official communications, as in the well-known compound 未確認飛行物体 (UFO).

examples.japanese: {未確認|みかくにん}の{情報|じょうほう}です。
{未確認|みかくにん}{飛行|ひこう}{物体|ぶったい}が{目撃|もくげき}された。
examples.english: An unidentified flying object was spotted.

examples.japanese: {被害|ひがい}の{全容|ぜんよう}はまだ{未確認|みかくにん}のままだ。
examples.english: The full extent of the damage remains unconfirmed.

notes:
A compound of {未|み} (not yet) and {確認|かくにん} (confirmation). Used as a noun modifier to indicate that something has not been verified or identified. Common in news reporting, official communications, and formal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未確認|みかくにん}{情報|じょうほう}: unconfirmed information/report
- {未確認|みかくにん}{飛行|ひこう}{物体|ぶったい}: unidentified flying object (UFO)
- {未確認|みかくにん}のまま: remaining unconfirmed
- {未確認|みかくにん}{生物|せいぶつ}: unidentified creature (UMA)

FORMS:
The prefix {未|み}～ indicates "not yet" and attaches to many two-kanji compounds:
- {未|み}{完成|かんせい}: incomplete
- {未|み}{解決|かいけつ}: unsolved
- {未|み}{経験|けいけん}: inexperienced
